# Vendored code

`preact-htm.js` is `htm/preact/standalone.module.js` from [htm](https://github.com/developit/htm) 3.1.1, copied unchanged. It bundles [Preact](https://github.com/preactjs/preact).

| Library | Licence | File |
| --- | --- | --- |
| htm | Apache License 2.0 | `LICENSE-htm.txt` |
| Preact | MIT | `LICENSE-preact.txt` |

These licences cover this folder only. The rest of the project is under the MIT licence in the root `LICENSE` file.
